infobox_fields: species: Host | gender: Male and Female characters | actor: Various | seasons: Season One, Season Two
text_excerpt: The settlers of Westworld are hosts who portray the civilian settlers of the Wild West, and are the broadest faction of the Westworld park. Description They include the people of the four main towns (Sweetwater, Las Mudas, Pariah, Escalante), settlers on family farms and ranches, prospectors and outdoor workers, shopkeepers, business owners and staff, and local law enforcement. Outwardly, the hosts of this faction show a wide range of various ethnic ancestries and occupational backgrounds.
